nodes.label: payday-data Persistent Docker Volume
nodes.rationale: Persists the SQLite database across container rebuilds and docker compose down.

nodes.label: Payday Platform
nodes.rationale: Engineered to focus deeply on the income side of personal finance rather than expense categorization or bank sync, giving instant and accurate visibility into net take-home earnings.

nodes.label: SQLite Database (salary.db, WAL Mode)
nodes.rationale: Uses Write-Ahead Logging (PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL), strict foreign key enforcement (PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON), CHECK constraints, and atomic transactions for reliability.

nodes.label: Zero-Dependency Python HTTP Service (backend/app.py)
nodes.rationale: Built on Python standard library modules (http.server, sqlite3, decimal, csv, json) for sub-millisecond execution overhead.

nodes.label: Core State, Sources, Paycheques & Settings API
nodes.norm_label: core state, sources, paycheques & settings api

nodes.label: Pay-Yourself-First Allocations (/allocations, allocation-engine.ts)
nodes.rationale: Configurable allocation rules and presets split paycheques into savings, investments, and spending buckets.

nodes.label: Integer Cents Representation
nodes.rationale: All monetary quantities (amount_cents, goal_cents) are stored and handled strictly as integer cents to eliminate floating-point rounding errors, converting to dollars only at presentation boundaries.

nodes.label: Relational Delete Protection (ON DELETE RESTRICT)
nodes.rationale: Foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT blocks deletion of an income source that has associated paycheques and prompts archiving instead to prevent orphaned records.

nodes.label: Bespoke Vanilla CSS Fintech Design System
nodes.norm_label: bespoke vanilla css fintech design system
nodes.rationale: Uses Outfit typography, DM Mono tabular numerals, custom CSS variables, responsive breakpoints, focus-visible rings, and prefers-reduced-motion compliance.

nodes.label: Predictive Payday Engine (computeUpcomingPaydays)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates the median gap across past deposits to forecast the next payout date, relative countdown, and estimated payout amount.

nodes.label: Yearly Goal & Pacing Engine
nodes.rationale: Projects year-end earnings from daily velocity ((goalSum / daysDone) * daysInYr) and computes required monthly runway (goalLeft / monthsLeft) against annual targets.

nodes.label: Paycheques Ledger (/paycheques)
nodes.rationale: Uses live client-side filtering without server roundtrips for instant responsiveness across year, source, and full-text search criteria.

nodes.label: Undoable Delete Toast & ARIA Live System
nodes.norm_label: undoable delete toast & aria live system
nodes.rationale: Deleting a paycheque displays a 7-second ARIA live notification toast with an Undo action so records can be restored seamlessly without confirmation friction.
